diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/widgets/files/folderMenuPopup.xhtml b/mail/base/test/browser/widgets/files/folderMenuPopup.xhtml
index 05d98697f82..ee866ba8ba6 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/widgets/files/folderMenuPopup.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/widgets/files/folderMenuPopup.xhtml
@@ -21,22 +21,29 @@
   <html:body xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul">
     noMode
     <menulist id="noMode" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"/>
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" native="false"/>
     </menulist>
 
     filingServers
     <menulist id="filingServers" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="filing" expandFolders="false"/>
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="filing"
+                 expandFolders="false"/>
     </menulist>
 
     filingFolders
     <menulist id="filingFolders" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="filing" showFileHereLabel="true"/>
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="filing"
+                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
     </menulist>
 
     filingServersAndFolders
     <menulist id="filingServersAndFolders" class="folderMenuItem">
       <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
                  mode="filing"
                  showAccountsFileHere="true"
                  showFileHereLabel="true"/>
@@ -45,6 +52,7 @@
     filingSpecials
     <menulist id="filingSpecials" class="folderMenuItem">
       <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
                  mode="filing"
                  showAccountsFileHere="true"
                  showFileHereLabel="true"
@@ -56,6 +64,7 @@
     searchServersAndFolders
     <menulist id="searchServersAndFolders" class="folderMenuItem">
       <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
                  mode="search"
                  showAccountsFileHere="true"
                  showFileHereLabel="true"/>
@@ -63,7 +72,10 @@
 
     getMail
     <menulist id="getMail" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="getMail" expandFolders="false">
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="getMail"
+                 expandFolders="false">
         <menuitem class="folderMenuItem" label="Static Item"/>
         <menuseparator/>
       </menupopup>
@@ -71,30 +83,42 @@
 
     newFolder
     <menulist id="newFolder" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="newFolder" showFileHereLabel="true" />
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="newFolder"
+                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
     </menulist>
 
     subscribe
     <menulist id="subscribe" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="subscribe" expandFolders="false" />
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="subscribe"
+                 expandFolders="false"/>
     </menulist>
 
     deferred
     <menulist id="deferred" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="deferred" expandFolders="false" />
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="deferred"
+                 expandFolders="false"/>
     </menulist>
 
     notDeferred
     <menulist id="notDeferred" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" mode="notDeferred" showFileHereLabel="true" />
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                 native="false"
+                 mode="notDeferred"
+                 showFileHereLabel="true"/>
     </menulist>
 
     feeds
     <menulist id="feeds" class="folderMenuItem">
-      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+      <menupopup is="folder-menupopup" native="false"
                  mode="feeds"
                  showFileHereLabel="true"
-                 showAccountsFileHere="true" />
+                 showAccountsFileHere="true"/>
     </menulist>
   </html:body>
 </html>
